  decision = {The UC2 intervals keep the single pooled calibration of EDN-85.
\texttt{evaluate} reports their coverage and width per make beside the pooled SC-05 figure, and the model card names the judged makes outside 88\,\% to 92\,\%.
Makes under 500 test rows are reported and not judged.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item Mondrian calibration, one offset pair per make: it fixes Mercedes-Benz on P1 (93.9\,\% to 91.7\,\%) and mostly Suzuki (85.9\,\% to 90.4\,\% full), but moves Alfa Romeo and Volvo out of the band and lowers Audi to 88.9\,\% on full inputs; four makes have too few rows to calibrate.
\item A larger calibration split: reopens the split of EDN-32 and needs a full retrain.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} The pooled figures pass SC-05 (90.2\,\% full, 91.0\,\% P1). Mercedes-Benz is in the band on full inputs (90.8\,\%) and over-covered on P1 (93.9\,\%), the safe direction. Suzuki is the real miss (85.9\,\% and 81.7\,\%). Calibrating per make on 1,000 to 3,000 rows only trades misses between makes.},
